messages:
sofia: CI canary on h100 warmup is flaking — failed 3/20 runs with an "unspecified launch failure" and "invalid device function" in the same spot. Repro window? @ci-bot please requeue the failing job :eyes:

ci-bot: Requeued job canary-3142 on node h100-a. https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/3142

alex: saw something similar yesterday. quick suspicion: leftover tempfiles / shared mount from previous run messing with GPU init. any recent init-container changes?

sofia: good call. stack trace has cuLaunchKernel then a page fault. excerpt: ```
[2024-11-15T14:12:03Z] ERROR cuLaunchKernel: invalid device function
[2024-11-15T14:12:03Z] runtime: page fault during kernel execution - address 0x7f9c0000
[callstack] quant_attention_forward +0x1a4
```

kai: can you try locally with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` and `--checksum-kv` so we at least rule out multi-gpu contention? also which driver/version on the failing node?

sofia: fleet driver is 535.113.02; the image uses CUDA 12.2. note: a different canary that passed earlier had driver 535.86 on host. not sure if that's relevant.

nina: if it's leftover NVML/driver state a node reboot usually clears it. i can block the node for a repro window in ~30m and run a couple of iterations.

alex: another quick triage: run the warmup with `--warmup-threads=1 --gpu-reinit=true` to see if reducing concurrency avoids the hit.

sofia: re-running now with those flags, will post results.

sofia: quick update — run with flags passed on first attempt, second attempt failed with same trace. more of the log: ```
E/cuLaunchKernel: kernel: quant_attention_forward (sm_80)
E/CUDA: cubin PTX mismatch? attempt to load cached cubin failed, falling back to JIT
E/CUDA: invalid device function
```

kai: quant_attention implies a specialized kernel; could be PTX vs cubin mismatch (architecture flags). do our images still build with both sm_80 and sm_90? we recently added sm_90 for L40 targets.

alex: if it's a kernel mismatch the failure mode being intermittent makes sense (cached cubin vs JIT race). plan: bisect between the last two images that changed build flags — 2024-11-02 (good) vs 2024-11-08 (suspect).

sofia: launching two pinned canaries for bisect now (one per image).

ci-bot: Canaries started: canary-3145 (img: redwood/serve:2024-11-02) and canary-3146 (img: redwood/serve:2024-11-08).

nina: if the bisect shows higher failure on 11-08 we should check the nvcc flags / docker build logs for `-gencode` entries. also consider capturing an `nsys` trace for a repro.

sofia: quick bisect update — both images eventually hit the failure but 2024-11-08 shows a higher failure rate (6/20 vs 1/20). looks like a flake amplified by a change. next: collect `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q` and driver logs from the failing host and open an infra ticket if driver skew is suspected.

alex: also try a warmup variant with `--no-kv-cache` to eliminate kvcache corruption as a contributor.

sofia: starting 5x runs with `--no-kv-cache --warmup-threads=1`. will paste outcomes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
